bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
SERVICE_ROOT="$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p WorkingDirectory --value)"
test "$(realpath "$SERVICE_ROOT")" = "$(realpath "$ROOT")" || exit 71
test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_room_smoke.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py)" || exit 72
test -z "$(git diff --name-only)" || exit 73
test -z "$(git diff --cached --name-only)" || exit 74
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 004757a1eeb5a847fd7adb7de5204f1575e4b3ba || exit 75
printf 'USERBOT_SOURCE_EXACT_BASE=PASS\n'
